environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU 6144 MiB

limitations: One optimizer step per batch; no convergence or evaluation.
Synthetic 64x48 images are resized/padded by the policy; real 640x480 data has the same policy-side resize but different decode/load cost.
Batch 16/32 OOM includes a 112 MB unrelated GPU process and allocator fragmentation; the exact boundary was not bisected.
No checkpoint was promoted; the step-1 checkpoint under /tmp was disposable.
No robot, DDS, camera or motion path was touched.
result: batch_size 8 fits with ~2.5 GB headroom; batch_size 16 OOM. M2 candidate batch 8 (or lower with gradient accumulation).
scope: SmolVLA fine-tune feasibility on the 6 GB RTX 3060 Laptop; one optimizer step per batch size; no policy promotion, no robot.
